blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.
blocks.zh: 以传播为基础的视频生成模型(VGMs)可以产生视觉上可信的视频,然而他们的相机自负-运动往往会漂移到长的地平线上. 相机自负-运动决定了视角在相框之间如何变化,对于保持相容的几何和轨迹至关重要. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立由两个部分组成的因果协调框架CausalAlign。 首先,我们通过线性探测和因果干预, 来判断自我运动的精确性, 使用和保留在VGM内部, 揭示了在解密期间的起伏模式。 其次,我们通过三角空基空间,将识别层的表达方式与3D基础模型相协调,从而加强了VGM中的自动机状态. 这个空间编码了相继相框之间的变化,使得对齐能够专注于自负-运动动态而不是静态场景内容. 随着Wan2.2在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上进行微调,CausalAlign可以在很大程度上提高运动精度,几何一致性,以及时间平滑性,同时保持视觉质量. 例如,相对于基模型,它能使几何一致性提高20%以上. 此外,随着VGM的微调,CausalAlign在RoboCasa365基准的移动操纵任务上将世界行动模型的成功率提高了10分. 总体而言,CausalAlign提高了基于传播的VGM的自负-运动一致性,并在所体现模式中取得了显著收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) have led to remarkable models such as Wan2.2 ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos3 ( NVIDIA Cosmos Team, 2026 ) .
Trained on Internet-scale collections of 2D videos, these models can synthesize visually compelling content ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
However, trained to model 2D appearance and local motion statistics, standard VGMs struggle to capture 3D camera trajectories and to control viewpoint changes consistently across frames ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kupyn et al., 2025 ) . We refer to these cross-frame viewpoint changes as camera ego-motion.
blocks.zh:
最近基于传播的视频生成模型(VGMs)的进步导致了Wan2.2(Team Wan等人,2025年)和Cosmos3(NVIDIA Cosmos Team,2026年)等引人注目的模型.
这些模型在互联网范围收集2D视频方面进行了培训,可以合成可视令人信服的内容(Huang等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年)。
然而,经过2D外观和局部运动统计模型培训,标准VGMs努力捕捉3D相机轨迹,并控制横跨帧的视角变化(Wu等人,2026年;Kupyn等人,2025年)。 我们把这些跨框架观点的改变称为相机自觉运动。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 1 (left panel), prior work has attempted to address this challenge by introducing explicit 3D priors or preference alignment ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Bahmani et al., 2025 ) , yet generating videos with geometrically consistent camera trajectories remains an open problem.
At the same time, recent work shows that VGMs can implicitly estimate camera poses from their internal representations, even when their generated trajectories are imperfect ( Bahmani et al., 2025 ) . This raises a more fundamental question: how is precise ego-motion represented, used, and retained within VGMs? This question becomes increasingly important when VGMs are integrated into world action models (WAMs) for robotic mobile manipulation: visually plausible yet geometrically inconsistent predictions of the future can induce systematic errors in downstream action prediction.
blocks.zh:
如图1(左面板)所示,先前的工作试图通过引入明确的3D前缀或偏好调整来应对这一挑战(Wang等人,2024年b; Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Bahmani et al., 2025),然而,制作带有几何一致的相机轨迹的视频仍然是一个公开的问题。
与此同时,最近的工作表明,VGMs可以隐含地估计其内部表达中的相机,即使其产生的轨迹不完美(Bahmani等人,2025年). 这提出了一个更根本性的问题:如何在VGM中准确反映、使用和保留自我运动? 当VGMs被集成到机器人移动操纵的世界行动模型中时,这个问题就变得日益重要:视觉上看似可行但几何上的不一致对未来的预测会引发下游行动预测的系统性错误.

Figure 1: Overview of CausalAlign. Left: Existing approaches rely on external 3D caches that may propagate errors, optimize output-level preferences without directly supervising ego-motion states, or align 3D features at randomly selected layers.
Middle: Our CausalAlign first identifies the targeted layers through causal diagnosis and then strengthens ego-motion states through delta-token alignment.
Right: CausalAlign consistently improves camera ego-motion consistency in video generation and largely boosts downstream mobile manipulation performance.
blocks.zh:
图1:CausalAlign概览。 左侧:现有方法依赖于外部的3D缓存,这些缓存可能传播错误,优化输出级偏好而不直接监督自我运动状态,或者在随机选择的层对齐3D特性.
中间:我们的CausalAlign首先通过因果诊断来识别目标层,然后通过三角形对齐来强化自我运动状态.
对:CausalAlign在视频生成中不断提高相机自负-运动一致性,并在很大程度上提升下游移动操纵性能.

blocks.en:
As the first step, we perform analysis for understanding the ego-motion information within VGMs.
Inspired by prior works ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) , we adopt linear probing to measure the internal representations of VGMs and causal intervention to reveal the mechanisms of VGMs.
Specifically, for linear probing, we define “decodability” as the amount of ego-motion information. Meanwhile, for causal intervention, we define “causal effect” as the extent to which the interventions on VGM can change the generation.
Our analysis results demonstrate that both measurements exhibit the same trend, that is, increasing first and then declining, across both denoising timesteps and denoising Transformer layers.
These results suggest that ego-motion state emerges as the denoising progresses, however, fades away at the late timesteps and the last few Transformer layers at each step.
Therefore, ego-motion is already learned and represented in VGMs, increasingly used at intermediate stages, yet not well retained at later stages. We refer to this progressive pattern as “geometric state forgetting” .
blocks.zh:
作为第一步,我们进行分析,以了解在VGM内部的自我运动信息。
在之前的作品(Alain and Bengio, 2016;Meng等人, 2022)的启发下,我们采用线性探险来测量VGM的内部表现和因果干预来揭示VGM的机制.
具体地说,对于线性测试,我们把“可解码性”定义为自我运动信息的数量。 同时,对于因果干预,我们把“因果关系”定义为对虚拟性别机制的干预能够改变这一代人的程度。
我们的分析结果表明,两种测量都呈现出同样的趋势,即首先增加,然后下降,既包括去诺定时步骤,也包括去诺定变压器层。
这些结果表明,自我运动状态随着消音的进步而出现,然而,在后期渐渐消退,每一步最后几层变形器层也逐渐消退.
因此,自我运动已经得到学习,并体现在VGM中,在中间阶段越来越多地使用,但在后期阶段却没有得到很好的保留。 我们把这种渐进模式称为“几何状态遗忘”。

blocks.en:
Motivated by this diagnosis, our goal is to preserve and strengthen the ego-motion state within VGMs without compromising the quality of visual generation.
To this end, we propose CausalAlign , a framework with two components: causal diagnosis and delta-token alignment, as shown in Figure 1 (middle panel).
First, causal diagnosis leverages linear probing and causal intervention to identify where ego-motion is represented, used, and forgotten within a VGM.
Second, delta-token alignment supervises the internal ego-motion state at the positions identified as forgetting.
There are two key challenges in our alignment: how to represent ego-motion with the hidden states in VGMs , and how to provide meaningful geometry supervision for such representations .
For the first challenge, we adopt the idea of delta tokens, which was initially designed for improving the efficiency of the world model ( Kerssies et al., 2026 ) . We adapt this idea to measure the ego-motion via the difference between two consecutive frames. Delta tokens serve as a natural carrier for motion information while reducing redundant static scene content.
For the second challenge, we construct the delta-token space by leveraging the pretrained 3D foundation model. These 3D models are capable of estimating camera poses, depth, and 3D structure, and thus can provide high-quality geometric supervision. A learnable projector then maps consecutive hidden-state transitions into this teacher delta-token space, explicitly supervising ego-motion state of the VGM.
By aligning these projected tokens with the corresponding teacher delta tokens at the identified layers, CausalAlign transfers geometric knowledge to the locations where ego-motion information starts to fade.
blocks.zh:
在这种诊断的激励下,我们的目标是在不破坏视觉生成质量的情况下,保持和加强VGM内部的自我运动状态.
为此,我们提议“CausalAlign”框架,其中包含两个组成部分:因果诊断和三角吻合,如图1(中间面板)所示。
首先,因果诊断利用线性检测和因果干预,确定自觉运动在VGM中表现、使用和被遗忘之处。
第二,三角形对接监督被确定为遗忘位置的内部自我运动状态。
如何代表自我与隐藏状态, 以及如何为这些表达提供有意义的几何监督。
对于第一个挑战,我们采纳了三角地标的概念,这个概念最初是为了提高世界模型的效率(Kersies等人,2026年). 我们调整这个想法,通过两个连续框之间的区别来衡量自我运动。 Delta标志作为运动信息的自然载体,同时减少多余的静态场景内容.
对于第二个挑战,我们通过利用预先训练的3D基础模型来构建三角洞空间. 这些3D模型能够估计相机的姿势,深度,和3D结构,因此可以提供高质量的几何监督. 一个可学习的投影仪然后将连续隐藏状态的过渡图映射到这个教师三角地洞空间,明确监督VGM的自我运动状态.
CausalAlign通过将这些预测的符号与识别层的相应教师三角洲符号对齐,将几何知识传输到自我运动信息开始消失的地点.

blocks.en:
With our CausalAlign method, we fine-tune the VGM on the widely-adopted datasets, DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) .
To evaluate the effects of CausalAlign on VGMs, we establish a comprehensive evaluation protocol with three aspects: visual quality, ego-motion consistency, and geometric state retention.
Visual quality is measured with VBench-I2V ( Huang et al., 2026 ) and complementary metrics.
Ego-motion consistency is evaluated through motion magnitude, geometric consistency, and temporal dynamics, while geometric-state retention is assessed through probe decodability and causal intervention effects.
CausalAlign preserves visual quality while improving camera ego-motion consistency, as shown in Figure 1 (right panel).
For example, it reduces reprojection error by 22.6% and improves trajectory smoothness by 23.9% relative to the base model.
It also alters the decodability and causal-effect patterns from rise-and-fall to rise-and-maintain , supporting the improved retention of ego-motion state.
Moreover, we observe that the improved ego-motion state can facilitate downstream applications, such as WAMs for embodied tasks. Specifically, our fine-tuned VGM raises success rate on RoboCasa365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) from 43.5% to 54.2% . These results validate our method with causal diagnosis and delta-token alignment.
blocks.zh:
用我们的CausalAlign方法,微调了VGM在广泛采用的数据集,DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)和RealEstate10K(Zhou等人,2018年).
为了评价CausalAlign对VGMs的影响,我们建立了一个全面的评价协议,包括三个方面:视觉质量、自我-运动一致性和几何状态保留。
视觉质量用V Bench-I2V(Huang等人,2026年)和辅助度量衡测量.
通过运动体积、几何一致性和时间动态来评价电子运动的一致性,而几何状态的保留通过探测解码和因果干预效应来评估。
如图1(右面板)所示,CausalAlign在提高相机自我-运动一致性的同时保持视觉质量.
例如,相对于基准模型,它能将再预测误差减少22.6%,使轨迹平滑度提高23.9%。
它还改变了可解码性和因果效应模式,从升降到升降并维持升降,支持更好地保持自我运动状态。
此外,我们还注意到,自我运动状态的改善可以促进下游的应用,例如用于包含的任务的WAM. 具体来说,我们经过微调的VGM将RoboCasa365(Nasiriany等人,2026年)的成功率从43.5%提高到54.2%。 这些结果证实了我们的方法与因果诊断和三角吻合。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows:
(1) We identify a pattern called “geometric state forgetting” which reveals the ego-motion state in diffusion-based VGMs. Through linear probing and causal intervention, our analysis reveals that ego-motion information is progressively represented and used during the denoising process, yet not retained at the late stages of denoising.
(2) We propose CausalAlign , a causal alignment method that aims to preserve ego-motion state at the VGM layers identified by our causal analysis. Our technical innovation lies in adapting the idea of delta tokens to strengthen ego-motion consistency via 3D foundation models.
(3) Extensive experiments and comprehensive metrics validate the benefits of our method. It largely improves ego-motion consistency, better preserves ego-motion state during denoising, and offers remarkable gains for WAM in robotic tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献概述如下:
(1) 我们确定了一种称为“几何状态遗忘”的模式,它揭示了基于扩散的VGM的自我运动状态。 通过线性测试和因果干预,我们的分析表明,自我运动信息在去诺化过程中逐渐得到体现和使用,但在去诺化的后期阶段却没有保留.
(2) 我们提出CausalAlign(CausalAlign),这是一种因果对齐方法,旨在保持由我们因果分析确定的VGM层的自我运动状态. 我们的技术创新在于通过3D基础模型来调整三角地标的概念,以加强自我运动的一致性.
(3)广泛的实验和综合衡量标准验证了我们的方法的好处。 它在很大程度上提高了自我运动的一致性,在消音时更好地保持了自我运动状态,并为WAM在机器人任务上提供了显著的收获.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video diffusion and world action models. Video diffusion extends image denoising to joint spatiotemporal generation ( Ho et al., 2022 ) , while open backbones such as Wan have broadened its use ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) .
Unlike image generation, VGMs require preserving temporal correspondences and scene geometry across multiple frames ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
These priors increasingly serve as action-conditioned simulators or policies: Genie and IRASim learn controllable future dynamics, while VideoVLA, DreamZero, and LingBot-VA couple observations with executable actions; Fast-WAM shows that video co-training can improve action representations without test-time video decoding ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
Therefore, ego-motion consistency is internally related to WAM and erroneous camera motion can corrupt the predicted actions.
Rather than proposing another WAM, CausalAlign restores and strengthens the ego-motion state of the VGM to facilitate WAM performance.
Our method elicits the knowledge that has been learned during VGM pretraining, providing an alternative route for stronger WAMs.
blocks.zh:
视频传播与世界行动模式. 视频传播将图像淡化扩展至联合spatiotal生成(Ho等人,2022年),而Wan等开放式骨干也拓宽了使用范围(Team Wan等人,2025年).
与图像生成不同,VGM需要保存跨越多个帧的时间对应和场景几何(黄等人,2024年;黄等人,2026年;Ren等人,2025年;张等人,2025年).
这些前科日益成为行动条件模拟器或政策: Genie和IRASim学习可控的未来动态,而VideoVLA,DreamZero,和LingBot-VA的观察结合可执行动作;Fast-WAM显示视频协同训练可以改善动作表现,而无需测试时间视频解码(Bruce等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年;Shen等人,2025年;Ye等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年a;袁等人,2026年).
因此,自我-运动一致性在内部与WAM有关,错误的相机运动会腐蚀预测的行动.
CausalAlign没有提议另一个WAM,而是恢复和加强VGM的自负感状态,以促进WAM的性能.
我们的方法吸引了在VGM预训期间学到的知识,为更强大的WAM提供了另一种途径.

blocks.en:
Feed-forward 3D reconstruction has progressed from point-map predictors such as DUSt3R and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025a ) to streaming
models with temporal state. CUT3R recurrently maintains a metric-scale scene representation ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , while LingBot-Map organizes streaming context into anchor, pose-reference, and trajectory memories and demonstrates improved trajectory and pose accuracy over VGGT ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . These models provide camera and scene representations that can serve as supervision for video generation. We thus adopt LingBot-Map as the teacher model and study how its ego-motion state can be transferred to a video generator.
blocks.zh:
feed-forward 3D重建从DUST3R和VGGT等点映射预测器(Wang等人,2024a; Wang等人,2025a)至溪流
具有时间状态的模型。 CUT3R经常保持一个测量尺度的场景表现(Wang等人,2025年b),而LingBot-Map则组织上下游上下文为锚,姿势参照,以及轨迹记忆,并显示改进的轨迹和对VGGT的精确度(Chen等人,2026年a). 这些模型提供相机和场景表现,可以作为视频生成的监督. 因此,我们采用LingBot-Map作为教师模式,并研究如何将其自我运动状态转移到视频生成器。

blocks.en:
As summarized in Figure 1 , existing geometry-aware adaptation methods can be categorized into three types.
External 3D cache methods such as GEN3C and Voyager use point cloud or world memories for controllable camera motion, yet require additional geometric memory and may propagate cache errors ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ) .
Preference alignment methods such as VideoGPA and Epipolar-DPO supervise generated videos through preference or epipolar feedback, without directly improving the VGM’s internal geometric state ( Du et al., 2026 ; Kupyn et al., 2025 ) .
Direct alignment methods, including JOG3R, Geometry Forcing, and FantasyWorld, transfer geometric features into the generator but do not explicitly target at effective timestep and layer locations ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) .
Complementary WAM methods leverage 3D, 4D, or action-grounded supervision to improve action representations without requiring auxiliary teachers at deployment ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
CausalAlign instead improves the internal ego-motion state of VGMs through delta-token space from 3D foundation models, at the locations identified by causal diagnosis.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,现有的几何意识适应方法可分为三类。
GEN3C和Voyager等外部3D缓存方法使用点云或世界记忆进行可控相机运动,然而需要额外的几何内存,并可能传播缓存错误(Ren等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年b).
VideoGPA和Epipolar-DPO等首选对齐方法通过偏好或上极反馈来监督生成的视频,但没有直接改善VGM的内部几何状态(Du等人,2026年;Kupyn等人,2025年).
直接对齐方法,包括JOG3R、几何逼真和幻想世界,将几何特征转移到生成器中,但没有在有效的时步和层位上明确瞄准(Huang等人,2025a); Wu等人, 2026; Dai等人, 2026).
补充性WAM方法利用3D,4D或基于行动的监督,改善行动表述,而无需部署辅助教师(李等人,2026b;张等人,2026;杨等人,2026;傅等人,2026;邱等人,2026).
相反,CausalAlign通过3D基础模型的三角脚本空间,在因果诊断确定的地点改善VGMs的内部自负-运动状态.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Three stages of CausalAlign training. CausalAlign transfers ego-motion knowledge from a 3D teacher to the VGM through three-stage training. In Stage 1, consecutive features from a streaming 3D foundation model are encoded into a teacher delta-token space that captures inter-frame geometric transitions. In Stage 2, a projector maps VGM DiT features into the same delta-token space and is frozen after training, using a small subset of the training split. In Stage 3, with full training split, LoRA adapters are optimized only at the identified VGM layers using delta tokens, while the projector remains frozen.
blocks.zh: 图2:CausalAlign培训的三个阶段。 CausalAlign通过三阶段培训,将3D教师的自我运动知识转移给VGM. 在阶段1中,从流式3D基础模型中连续的特征被编码成教师三角脚本空间,可以捕捉帧间几何过渡. 在阶段2中,一个投影仪将VGM DIT的特征映射到同一个三角形托盘空间,并在训练后被冻结,使用训练分裂的一小子集. 在第3阶段,在完全训练分开的情况下,LORA适配器只在识别的VGM层使用三角形符号进行优化,而投影器则保持冷冻.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Method Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 方法概述

blocks.en:
CausalAlign combines causal diagnosis and delta-token alignment to preserve ego-motion representations in diffusion-based VGMs.
We first conduct causal diagnosis to identify the layers and the denoising timesteps where ego-motion information fades.
Guided by the causal diagnosis, we align the VGM using delta tokens in three stages. First, we learn delta tokens from a frozen 3D foundation model. Second, we train projectors to map the temporal transitions of VGM features into this space. Finally, we use these tokens to supervise LoRA updates at the identified layers and denoising timesteps, while keeping the original VGM backbone, teacher, and projectors frozen.
In this way, CausalAlign strengthens the geometric knowledge encoded in the VGM without introducing additional computation during video generation.
blocks.zh:
CausalAlign结合了因果诊断和三角吻合,以在基于扩散的VGM中保持自我运动表现.
我们首先进行因果诊断 找出自我运动信息消退的层层和消音时间步
在因果诊断的指引下,我们把VGM使用三角形符号进行三阶段的调整. 首先,我们从一个冷冻的3D基础模型中学习三角形符号. 第二,我们训练投影仪将VGM特征的时间过渡映射到这个空间. 最后,我们用这些符号来监督LORA在识别层的更新和去诺定时步骤,同时保持原有的VGM主干线,老师,和投影仪的冻结.
通过这种方式,CausalAlign加强了VGM中编码的几何知识,在视频生成过程中没有引入额外的计算.

blocks.en: 3.4 Inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 推论

blocks.en:
At inference, CausalAlign follows the same video generation procedure as the original Wan2.2 ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) .
Given an initial frame and a text prompt, the adapted VGM generates a video through the standard denoising and decoding process.
All auxiliary modules used during training, including the 3D foundation model, are no longer needed.
Therefore, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency without requiring additional inputs or geometric computation during video generation.
blocks.zh:

由于初始帧和文本提示,经过调整的VGM通过标准的解码和解码程序生成视频.
培训中使用的所有辅助模块,包括3D基础模型,已不再需要。
因此,CausalAlign改进了自我运动的一致性,在视频生成过程中不需要额外的投入或几何计算.

blocks.en: 3.5 Application to World Action Models
blocks.zh: 3.5 适用于世界行动模式

blocks.en:
Consistent ego-motion is important for mobile manipulation, where robots predict actions while their viewpoints change.
We thus investigate whether improving the ego-motion state of VGMs can also benefit action prediction of world action models.
Specifically, we initialize the video expert of Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) with our adapted Wan2.2 model.
For the action expert, we follow Fast-WAM and transform the parameters of the original Wan model to initialize ActionDiT.
We train both experts using the original objectives for flow matching: ℒ WAM = ℒ FM v + ℒ FM a , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{WAM}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}^{v}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}^{a}, (12) where v v and a a denote the video and action experts, respectively.
The policy receives synchronized images from three camera views and predicts actions starting from the current observation.
Future video is used as a training target, while at inference, the policy predicts executable actions from the observed history without generating future video ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .

具体地说,我们用我们经过改造的Wan2.2模型初始化了Fast-WAM(袁等人,2026年)的视频专家.
对于动作专家,我们遵循Fast-WAM,并改造原Wan模型的参数,以初始化ActionDIT.

策略接收从三个镜头视图中同步的图像,并预测从当前观测开始的动作.
未来视频被用作训练目标,而政策推论则预测从观测历史中可执行的行动,而不产生未来视频(袁等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Ego-motion diagnosis and retention. We compare base model Wan2.2 and our method CausalAlign through probe decodability and causal intervention effects across layers (sub-figure (a) & (b): results are averaged over timesteps) and across denoising timesteps (sub-figure (c) & (d): results are averaged over layers).
Dashed vertical lines represent the selected alignment locations and shading shows the 10th–90th percentiles over the averaged dimension.
Our method CausalAlign can raise both signals from rise-and-fall to rise-and-maintain pattern, indicating improved ego-motion retention.
blocks.zh:
图3:情感诊断和保留。 我们通过探针可解码性和跨层的因果干预效应来比较基准模型Wan2.2和我们的方法CausalAlign(子图(a)和(b):结果在时间段内平均)和跨去通知时间段内平均(子图(c)和(d):结果在层内平均)。
折叠的垂直线代表了选定的对齐位置,阴影显示的是平均维度的第10-90百分位数。
我们的方法"CausalAlign"可以发出两个信号,从起伏到起伏和保持起伏的规律,表明自我运动得到更好的保持.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We first conduct causal diagnosis to identify where ego-motion information fades and examine whether CausalAlign improves its retention.
We then fine-tune the VGM with delta-token supervision at these locations and evaluate its ego-motion consistency, visual quality, and the benefits for embodied tasks.
Finally, we conduct ablation studies to validate our design choices.
blocks.zh:
我们首先进行因果诊断,以确定自我运动信息消退之处,并审查CausalAlign是否改善了信息的保存。
然后,我们通过这些地点的三角形监督,对VGM进行微调,并评估其自我运动的一致性、视觉质量和对包含的任务的好处。
最后,我们进行消化研究,验证我们的设计选择。

blocks.en: 4.1 Causal Diagnosis and Target Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1 因果关系诊断和选择目标

blocks.en:
Setup. We freeze Wan2.2 ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) and diagnose the hidden states across Transformer layers and across denoising steps.
At each location c = ( ℓ , s ) c=(\ell,s) , a linear readout predicts relative camera motion, yielding a decodability score 𝒟 ℓ , s \mathcal{D}_{\ell,s} .
We also apply the causal interventions introduced in Section 3.2 and measure their effects on the generated camera trajectory, yielding a causal effect score 𝒞 ℓ , s \mathcal{C}_{\ell,s} .
Figure 3 summarizes the resulting layer–timestep profiles.
blocks.zh:
设置. 我们冻结了Wan2.2(Team Wan等人,2025年),并诊断了变形金刚两层的隐藏状态和虚构步骤。
在c = (l, s) c = (\ell, s),线性读取预言相对相机运动,产生可解码分数 D l, s\ mathcal{D}_{\ell, s}.
我们还应用第3.2节引入的因果干预,并测量其对生成的相机轨迹的影响,得出因果分数C1,s\mathcal{C}_{\ell,s}.
图3概述了由此产生的层-时间步剖面。

blocks.en:
Diagnosis and target selection. Both geometric decodability and causal effect in the original Wan2.2 exhibit a consistent rise-and-fall pattern.
Their increase at intermediate locations indicates that the VGM forms and uses an ego-motion state, while their subsequent decline suggests that this state is not retained during later denoising.
By applying the target selection rule from Section 3.2 , we select layers 14, 10, 12, and 20 in descending order of their layer-wise decline rates.
Layer 14 is the primary target, while layers 10, 12, and 20 are auxiliary targets.
The same rule applies to denoising timesteps s ∈ { 398,799 } s\in\{398,799\} .
Both selected timesteps are used at all selected layers, with weights proportional to their positive temporal decline rates.
blocks.zh:
诊断与目标选择. 最初的Wan2.2中的几何解码和因果都表现出一贯的升降模式.
它们在中间位置的增加表明VGM的形式和使用自我运动状态,而他们的随后的衰落则表明这种状态在后来的去诺状态中不被保留.
通过应用第3.2节的目标选择规则,我们选择了第14、10、12和20层,按其分层下降率的降序排列。
第14层是首要目标,第10,12,20层是辅助目标.
同样的规则也适用于去诺定时台阶s {398,799} s\in {398,799} .
两个选定的时序都用于所有选定的地层,其权重与其正时衰减率成正比.

blocks.en:
The benefits of our method. After alignment, CausalAlign retains both probe decodability and causal effects at later denoising stages, changing the original rise-and-fall pattern into a rise-and-maintain pattern, as shown by the orange curve in Figure 3 .
The sustained causal effects indicate that ego-motion information remains influential during generation, rather than merely becoming more decodable.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法的好处。 在对齐后,CausalAlign保留了探测器的可解码性和在后来的解诺阶段的因果效应,将原来的升降模式改变为升降模式,如图3中的橙色曲线所示.
持续的因果效应表明,自我运动信息在一代人的时间里仍然具有影响力,而不是仅仅变得更容易解密。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experiments on the Comprehensive Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 综合评价实验

blocks.en:
Setup. We apply CausalAlign to Wan2.2-14B-I2V ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) and train it on datasets DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) .
We choose these datasets since they provide camera pose annotations and cover diverse scenes and camera movements, making them suitable for supervising and evaluating ego-motion consistency.
For each dataset, 90% of the data is used for training and 10% of the data is for evaluation.
As in Figure 2 , we first learn delta tokens from the geometric features of a frozen 3D foundation model using 30% of the training data.
We then train projectors to map features from the video generator into this delta-token space using 10% of the training data.
Finally, we fine-tune the generator with LoRA at the identified layers and denoising steps using the full training split. The 3D teacher and the projectors are needed only during training.
For evaluation, we use the same video length, resolution, frame rate, sampling settings, and random seeds across methods, and average results over multiple samples for each input.
Further details are provided in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh:
设置. 我们把CausalAlign应用到Wan2.2-14B-I2V (Team Wan等人,2025年),并在数据集DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)和RealEstate10K(Zhou等人,2018年)上对其进行培训.
我们选择这些数据集,因为它们提供相机呈现说明,并覆盖各种场景和相机运动,使它们适合监督和评估自我运动的一致性。
每个数据集90%的数据用于培训,10%的数据用于评估。
如图2所示,我们首先利用30%的培训数据,从冷冻的3D基础模型的几何特征中学习三角形符号。
然后我们用10%的训练数据 训练投影仪将图像生成器的特性映射到这个三角洞空间
最后,我们用LORA对发电机进行分层微调,并使用全部的训练分层进行调试。 只有在培训期间才需要3D教师和投影师。
对于评价,我们使用相同的视频长度,分辨率,帧率,抽样设置,以及不同方法的随机种子,每个输入的多个样本的平均结果.
详情见附录B.2。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare CausalAlign with the base model Wan2.2 and three groups of methods for improving geometric consistency. External 3D cache methods , including GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) and Voyager ( Huang et al., 2025b ) , control camera motion using explicit trajectories and 3D caches.
We follow their standard inference procedures by providing the reference camera trajectory and constructing a new 3D cache from the available input frames, without using future frames. Preference alignment methods , including VideoGPA ( Du et al., 2026 ) and Epipolar-DPO ( Kupyn et al., 2025 ) , improve generated videos through preference or epipolar feedback. Direct feature alignment methods , including JOG3R ( Huang et al., 2025a ) , Geometry Forcing ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and FantasyWorld ( Dai et al., 2026 ) , transfer geometric features into the generator.
For Wan2.2, CausalAlign, and methods without explicit camera control, we provide only the first frame and a text prompt.
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较了CausalAlign与基础模型Wan2.2和三组方法,以提高几何一致性. 外部3D缓存方法,包括GEN3C(Ren等人,2025年)和Voyager(Huang等人,2025年b),使用明确的轨迹和3D缓存控制相机运动.
我们遵循他们的标准推论程序,提供参考相机轨迹,从可用的输入框中构建一个新的3D缓存,而不使用未来的帧. 优惠调整方法,包括视频GPA (Du等人,2026年)和Epipolar-DPO(Kupyn等人,2025年)通过偏好或极地反馈改进生成的视频. 直接特征对齐方法,包括JOG3R(黄某1等人,2025a),几何法力(吴某1等人,2026),以及最终幻想世界(戴某1等人,2026),将几何特征转移到生成器中.
对于Wan2.2,CausalAlign,和没有明确相机控制的方法,我们只提供第一个帧和一个文本提示.

blocks.en:
Metrics. We use the same frozen estimators ( Wang et al., 2025a ) to recover camera poses, depth, optical flow, and visual features from every generated video.
Our evaluation covers three complementary aspects. Motion Magnitude measures how closely the mean translational and angular speeds match the corresponding means from real validation videos (Appendix B.1 ). Geometric Consistency measures reprojection error ( Triggs et al., 2000 ) , consistency between depth and optical flow in static regions ( Luo et al., 2020 ) , and epipolar error ( Lee and Civera, 2020 ) . Temporal Dynamics measures trajectory smoothness and jerk ( Hogan and Sternad, 2009 ; Flash and Hogan, 1985 ) , capturing continuity of motion and abrupt changes in acceleration.
Since the first frame and a text prompt can admit several valid future camera trajectories, we measure intrinsic consistency rather than error against a single reference trajectory (Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们用同样的冷冻估计器(Wang等人,2025年a)从每一个生成的视频中恢复相机的姿势,深度,光学流,以及视觉特征.
我们的评价涉及三个相辅相成的方面。 Motion Magnitude度量了平均翻译速度和角速度与真实验证视频(Appendix B.1 )中相应的手段相匹配的程度. 几何一致性测量再预测误差(Triggs等人,2000年),静态区域深度与光学流量的一致性(Luo等人,2020年),以及突起误差(Lee and Civera,2020年). Temperal Dynamics 测量轨迹平滑和混蛋(Hogan and Sternad,2009年;Flash and Hogan,1985年),捕捉运动的连续性和加速的突然变化。
由于第一个帧和一个文本提示可以承认几个有效的未来相机轨迹,因此我们对照一个单一的参考轨迹(Appendix B.2 )来测量内在一致性而不是错误.

blocks.en: Table 1: Camera ego-motion consistency. We evaluate videos generated from the DL3DV and RealEstate10K evaluation splits with the same estimators and generation settings. Methods without camera control receive the first frame and text prompt; methods that require control also receive camera trajectories and 3D caches. Bold indicates the best result for each metric. CausalAlign improves all seven metrics over Wan2.2 and leads on six of seven metrics.
blocks.zh: 表1:相机自负动作一致性. 我们评价从DL3DV和RealEstate10K评价中产生的视频与同样的估计器和生成设置分开. 没有相机控制的方法得到第一个帧和文本提示;需要控制的方法也得到相机轨迹和3D缓存. 粗体表示每个衡量标准的最佳结果。 CausalAlign在Wan2.2上改进了所有7个度量衡,领先于7个度量衡中的6个.

blocks.en:
Comparison with Baseline Methods. As shown in Table 1 , CausalAlign improves all seven metrics over Wan2.2 and achieves the best results on six of seven metrics among the compared methods.
For example, it reduces reprojection error from 8.4 to 6.5 pixels (22.6%), raises trajectory smoothness from 0.71 to 0.88 (23.9%), and lowers jerk from 0.182 to 0.151.
Further, its proximity to real camera speeds improves for both translation (0.68 to 0.79) and rotation (0.70 to 0.89), while epipolar error decreases from 2.9 to 2.1 pixels.
FantasyWorld achieves a slightly lower error for consistency between depth and flow (5.4 versus 5.5 pixels), but CausalAlign leads on the other six metrics without requiring a camera trajectory.
These results suggest that causal alignment through delta tokens strengthens the generator’s ability to produce consistent camera motion and scene geometry.
The examples in Figure 4 further show less trajectory jitter and drift when the camera completes a loop, compared with Wan2.2.
blocks.zh:
与基线方法的比较。 如表1所示,CausalAlign在Wan2.2的基础上改进了所有7个度量,在比较方法中,在7个度量中,有6个度量得到了最佳结果。
例如,它将重投射误差从8.4像素(22.6%)降低到6.5像素(22.6%),将轨迹平滑度从0.71提高到0.88(23.9%),将混蛋从0.182降至0.151.
此外,其与真相机速度的接近性既能改善翻译(0.68到0.79),又能改善旋转(0.70到0.89),而前极性误差则从2.9像素降低到2.1像素.
FantasyWorld在深度和流量的一致性上实现了略低的误差(5.4对5.5像素),但CausalAlign领先于其他6个度量衡而不需要相机轨迹.
这些结果表明,通过三角地标进行因果对齐可以加强发电机产生一致相机运动和场景几何的能力.
图4中的例子进一步显示,与Wan2.2相比,相机完成一个环时,轨迹的颤抖和漂移程度较低。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of ego-motion. We compare frames and reconstructed camera trajectories from Wan2.2 and CausalAlign in two scenes. CausalAlign shows less trajectory jitter in the top example and less drift when the camera completes a loop in the bottom example.
blocks.zh: 图4:自我运动定性比较. 我们在两个场景中比较了Wan2.2和CausalAlign的帧和重构的相机轨迹. CausalAlign在顶端示例中显示轨迹的抖动较少,当相机在底端示例中完成环时显示漂移较少.

blocks.en:
Further, we examine whether stronger geometric supervision harms visual quality. Specifically, we evaluate CausalAlign and Wan2.2 on the same evaluation clips with identical prompts, sampling settings, and random seeds.
We report VBench-I2V quality, I2V score, and smoothness ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , together with FVD, CLIP, SSIM, and LPIPS ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ; Radford et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2004 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
As shown in Table 2 , CausalAlign preserves visual quality comparable to Wan2.2: VBench quality increases slightly from 0.805 to 0.806, I2V score remains 0.958, and VBench smoothness rises from 0.983 to 0.985.
Further, CLIP and SSIM improve slightly, LPIPS remains unchanged, and FVD changes only marginally (182.4 to 182.7).
These results indicate that our method can improve ego-motion consistency without sacrificing visual fidelity.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们审查加强几何监督是否损害视觉质量。 具体来说,我们对CausalAlign和Wan2.2的评价片段进行了评估,这些片段带有相同的提示,取样设置,以及随机种子.
我们报告V Bench-I2V质量,I2V得分,以及平滑度(黄 al等人,2024年;黄 Huang等人,2026年),连同FVD,CLIP,SSIM,和LPIPS(Unterthiner等人,2018年;拉德福德等人,2021年;王 al等人,2004年;张 Zhang等人,2018年).
如表2所示,CausalAlign保持与Wan2.2相当的视觉质量: V Bench质量从0.805略微提升到0.806,I2V分数仍为0.958,V Bench平滑度从0.983升至0.985.
此外,CLIP和SSIM略有改善,LPIPS保持不变,FVD仅略有变化(182.4到182.7).
这些结果表明,我们的方法可以提高自我运动的一致性,而不牺牲视觉上的忠诚。

blocks.en: Table 2: Visual quality preservation. We evaluate Wan2.2 and CausalAlign using VBench-I2V (quality, I2V score, and smoothness) together with FVD, CLIP, SSIM, and LPIPS. Bold indicates the best result for each metric, including ties. CausalAlign preserves visual quality comparable to Wan2.2.
blocks.zh: 表2:视觉质量保护。 我们利用V Bench-I2V(质量、I2V分数和光滑度)与FVD、CLIP、SSIM和LPIPS一起评估Wan2.2和CausalAlign。 粗体表示每个衡量标准的最佳结果,包括联系。 CausalAlign保留了与Wan2.2相当的视觉质量.

blocks.en:
Given that CausalAlign improves the retention of ego-motion information in VGMs, we wonder whether this benefit can transfer to the embodied models which are built on top of VGMs.
We initialize the video expert of Fast-WAM with our fine-tuned Wan2.2 and evaluate the resulting policy on RoboCasa365 Target100 ( Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) .
Following Fast-WAM, the policy is pretrained on Human300 and then trained with 500 target demonstrations per task. The Atomic Seen evaluation includes 18 tasks with 50 rollouts each.
After 50k steps of fine-tuning, the policy takes images from three cameras and the current proprioceptive state as input. It predicts 32 actions in ten denoising steps and executes eight actions before replanning at 20 Hz.
As shown in Table 3 , CausalAlign + Fast-WAM raises average success from 43.5% to 54.2% (+10.7 percentage points) and success on Atomic Seen tasks from 59.1% to 78.1% (+19.0 points, 703/900 successful rollouts).
Further, success on Composite Seen tasks increases from 36.4% to 40.8%, and success on Composite Unseen tasks rises from 33.2% to 40.6%, suggesting that stronger ego-motion representations can benefit mobile manipulation.
Additional rollouts are shown in Appendix B.5 .
blocks.zh:
鉴于CausalAlign在VGMs中改进了自我运动信息的保存,我们想知道这种好处是否能够转移到包含在VGM之上的模型上.
Fast-WAM的视频专家用精细的Wan2.2进行初始化,
在Fast-WAM之后,该政策在Human300上进行预先培训,然后每任务培训500个目标演示. 原子观测评价包括18项任务,每个任务50次。
经过50千步的微调后,政策从三台相机和当前自控状态的图像中取出作为输入. 它预测在10个解密步骤中的32个行动,并在20赫兹重新规划前执行8个行动.
如表3所示,CausalAlign + Fast-WAM将平均成功率从43.5%提高到54.2%(+10.7个百分点),原子观测任务的成功率从59.1%提高到78.1%(+19.0分,703/900成功推出)。
此外,综合可见任务的成功率从36.4%上升到40.8%,综合可见任务的成功率从33.2%上升到40.6%,这表明更强大的自我运动表现可以有利于移动操纵。
附录B.5列出了其他推广情况。

blocks.en: Table 3: Transfer to world action models. We report success rates (%) on the three RoboCasa365 Target100 task groups. Bold marks the best value in each column, including ties. CausalAlign improves Fast-WAM across all three groups, increasing average success from 43.5% to 54.2% and Atomic-Seen success by 19.0 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表3:向世界行动模式的转让。 我们报告三个RoboCasa365目标工作组的成功率(%)。 粗体标出每个栏中的最佳值,包括领带. CausalAlign改进了所有三个群体的快速WAM,平均成功率从43.5%提高到54.2%,原子观测成功率提高了19.0%。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 4: Delta-token ablations. We compare (a) semantic regions with matched-width PCA projections of equally supervised unpartitioned encoders and (b) 128D delta tokens with original 8192D/4096D LingBot-Map features. Best values within each panel are bold. Delta tokens lead all six metrics in both panels.
blocks.zh: 表4:三角洲爆炸。 我们比较了(a) 具有同等监督的无分隔编码器的相匹配磁共振磁共振区和(b) 128D三角形符号与原始8192D/4096D 灵宝-Map功能. 每个面板中的最佳价值是大胆的。 三角洲标志在两个面板中都领先所有六个度量.

blocks.en:
Semantic partitioning. We first investigate whether separating delta-token into motion, geometry, and visual information helps the model learn a more effective representation.
To this end, we compare our structured delta tokens, consisting of 64D ego-motion, 40D geometry, and 24D visual regions, with two unpartitioned 128D encoders.
All encoders receive the same supervision, and we use PCA to project the unpartitioned representations to the corresponding dimensions.
As shown in Table 4 (a), our structured representation outperforms both alternatives across all six metrics.
Further, the cross-probes in Appendix C.1 show that each region performs best on its corresponding task.
These results suggest that explicitly separating different types of information helps the model learn more effective representations of ego-motion.
blocks.zh:
语义分化. 我们首先调查 将三角形分离成运动 几何和视觉信息是否有助于模型 学习更有效的表现
为此,我们比较了结构化的三角洲符号,包括64D自负-运动,40D几何,和24D视觉区域,与两个未分割的128D编码器.
所有编码器都接受同样的监督,我们利用PCA将未分化的表示投射到相应的维度.
如表4(a)所示,我们结构化的表述方式在所有6个衡量标准中都超过了两种选择。
此外,附录C.1中的交叉试探表明,每个区域在相应任务方面表现最好。
这些结果表明,明确分离不同类型的信息有助于模型学习更有效的自我运动表现。

blocks.en:
Complete-space comparison. We next examine whether learning delta tokens provides advantages over directly using the raw features of a pretrained 3D foundation model.
We compare our 128D delta tokens with two representations from LingBot-Map: the concatenated features of consecutive frames (8192D) and their difference (4096D).
Both original representations retain their full dimensions.
As shown in Table 4 (b), our delta tokens outperform both alternatives across all six metrics, despite using substantially fewer dimensions.
For example, the rotation error decreases from 3.243 to 2.530 degrees compared with the original feature pair.
These results suggest that learning a compact representation of temporal changes is more effective than directly using the original pooled 3D features.
blocks.zh:
完全空间比较. 我们接下来审查学习三角地标是否提供优势,而不是直接使用预先训练的3D基础模型的原始特征.
我们把我们的128D三角地标与LingBot-Map的两个表示物进行比较:连续帧(8192D)的缩合特征及其差异(4096D).
两份原始陈述都保留了全部内容。
如表4(b)所示,我们的三角洲标志在所有6个度量中都超过了两种替代品,尽管使用维度要小得多。
例如,与原功能对比,旋转误差从3.243度降至2.530度.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce CausalAlign , a causal alignment framework for ego-motion consistent video generation.
By linear probing and causal interventions, we show that video generation models already learned and used ego-motion state during denoising but did not retain it well at the late stages, a pattern we call “geometric state forgetting”.
CausalAlign targets at the locations where such forgetting is identified, and aligns ego-motion states with the delta-token space from a 3D foundation model.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that CausalAlign consistently improves ego-motion consistency and temporal dynamics while preserving visual quality. It mitigates geometric state forgetting by changing the pattern of ego-motion state from rise-and-fall to rise-and-maintain.
Further, our improved VGM largely raises the success rate of WAM on the mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365.
We hope this work can inspire the research on preserving geometric states of generative video models and the research on enhancing embodied models.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了CausalAlign, 一个因果校正框架,
通过线性检测和因果干预,我们显示,视频生成模型在消音时已经学会并使用了自我运动状态,但在后期没有很好地保持这种状态,我们称之为“几何状态遗忘”。
CausalAlign 目标在识别这种遗忘的地点, 并调整自我运动状态 三角形空间 从三维基础模型。
广泛的实验表明,CausalAlign在保持视觉质量的同时,不断提高自我运动的一致性和时间动态. 它通过改变自我运动状态的规律,从升降状态转变为升降状态,从而减轻了几何状态的遗忘.
此外,我们改进后的VGM在很大程度上提高了WAM在RoboCasa365的移动操纵任务上的成功率.
我们希望这项工作能够激励研究如何保存基因视频模型的几何状态,以及研究如何增强包含的模型。

latent before the measured hidden-state signals decline, as suggested by
the early emergence of camera motion reported in AC3D [ Bahmani et al., 2025 ] .

summarized in Fig. 5 .

blocks.en: C.3 Auxiliary Objectives and Update Strength
blocks.zh: C.3 辅助目标和最新力量

blocks.en: We compare local relative-pose supervision (RPE), kinematic supervision (speed, acceleration, and jerk), and their combination on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. The three runs continue from the same parent checkpoint to the same endpoint, step 48. Local RPE gives the largest trajectory gain ( 3.525 % 3.525\% ), with improvements concentrated in endpoint and motion-dynamics errors. Combining objectives reduces this gain to 1.299 % 1.299\% while improving geometry and temporal preservation (Table 10 ).
